notes: Sheet is drawn rotated about 45 deg (north arrow points to the upper right), so page-vertical streets (Culvert, Eggleston, Lock) run NW-SE on the ground and the page NW-SE diagonals (7th, 8th) run E-W. Names: 'E 7th St.', 'New St.', 'E. 6th', 'Pioneer St.', 'E. 5th', 'Culvert', 'Eggleston' / 'Eggleston Av.', 'Lock' / 'Lock St.', 'E 8th' (on both the NW-SE leg and the short page-horizontal leg east of Lock), 'Baum', 'Kilgour St.', 'Reedy St.'. Culvert/7th is a Y (7th ends where Culvert bends); point is the centroid of the three centreline crossings. Culvert/8th: Culvert's NE leg crosses a 78 ft strip (part of the 'Re-inforced Concrete Viaduct', which then runs page-east as a box x 1290-1890, y 712-1000 over Eggleston and the railroad) and meets E 8th (66') at grade on the strip's NE side. E 8th runs NW-SE across the top, over the viaduct box, and continues SE (50') to Lock; its crossing with Eggleston is grade-separated under the viaduct and its geometry there is unclear, so it is not recorded. Lock/8th (first entry) is the junction where 8th (from NW) ends, Lock bends into the diagonal 'Lock St.'; point is the centroid of the three centreline crossings. Second Lock/8th entry is the short E 8th leg running page-east from Lock (about 44 ft wide). Lock/5th: 5th jogs and narrows at Lock; point is the centre of the four corners. Baum/6th: 6th bends NE where Baum leaves to the SE; point is the centre of the junction. Baum/5th: Baum and 5th meet end to end (an L): 5th ends against Baum's east side (stone retaining wall) where Baum's pipe turns into 5th; recorded as T at the centreline crossing. East of the retaining wall another 37 ft way with a water pipe runs parallel to Baum toward the sheet edge (unnamed, no intersection on sheet). Eggleston width 91' printed at 5th; west block line drifts from x 1382 (top) to 1404 (bottom).
